mechanism_narrative: Stable inflation as measured by CPIAUCSL (current value 260.209) supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 270 and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an easing monetary policy, which compresses discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5) signals a monetary policy response to economic weakness, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND UNRATE > 7.5 and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.
